name: Hirah
title: Judah's Friend from Adullam
summary: Hirah was an Adullamite who was a friend of Judah, Jacob's son. He played a role in connection with Judah's marriage and the events surrounding Tamar. Hirah served as an intermediary for Judah on several occasions and is mentioned in Genesis 38.

keyEvents.title: Judah Goes Down to Hirah
keyEvents.description: Judah left his brothers and went down to a man in Adullam named Hirah, where he settled.

keyEvents.title: Judah's Marriage Through Hirah's Connection
keyEvents.description: While Judah was staying with Hirah, he met a Canaanite woman, the daughter of Shua, and took her as his wife.

keyEvents.title: Judah and Hirah at the Sheep Shearing
keyEvents.description: Judah went up to Timnah with his friend Hirah from Adullam to shear his sheep.

keyEvents.title: Hirah Is Sent with the Kid Goat
keyEvents.description: Judah sent his friend Hirah the Adullamite with a young goat as payment to the woman he had been with, but Hirah could not find her.

keyEvents.title: Hirah asks for the woman
keyEvents.description: Hirah asked the men at the place about the prostitute by the road, but they said there had never been a prostitute there.

keyEvents.title: Hirah brings word back to Judah
keyEvents.description: Hirah returned to Judah and reported that he had not found the woman, and that the people at the place said no such woman existed there.
